title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing a degree in CS or related technical discipline; proficiency in C++, Java, or Python.
description: Work on real-world projects that impact millions of users, collaborating with senior engineers across core systems, web applications, and AI infrastructure.

title: Associate Software Engineer
eligibility: Recent graduates or candidates with 0-2 years of software engineering experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
description: Design, build, and test software solutions across Microsoft Azure and Office product lines, learning enterprise software lifecycle best practices.

title: Junior Web Engineer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with strong fundamentals in web development and open-source software.
qualification: Experience in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, or Python; passion for open-source ecosystems.
description: Develop and maintain public web applications for Ubuntu and Canonical services in a distributed, international team setting.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Non-UK citizens applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Covers full tuition, living allowance, travel costs, and academic development funding for postgraduate study at Cambridge.

title: Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16 and older worldwide, working individually or in teams of up to 4.
qualification: Enrolled student at an accredited high school, college, or university.
description: Global student technology competition encouraging participants to build innovative tech solutions using Microsoft Azure cloud services.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone globally with an internet connection; beginner-friendly.
description: Learn foundational computer science concepts, algorithmic thinking, and software engineering in C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
